metric: BEV and upright 3D AP; paired vehicle/infrastructure, cooperative world GT projected to vehicle; no injected delay
ap_convention: VOC2010 precision-envelope integral; global score sorting; not KITTI R11/R40
iou_3d: rotated BEV intersection area times height overlap / volume union

feature_packets.scope: serialized road feature payload and metadata; excludes network framing/retransmission

transport_semantics: Original session_zlib/256-event-packet prefix reference budget; actual transport is one E3GS1 cumulative count snapshot with full metadata. No event-order preservation, no snapshot-budget optimization, no online incremental protocol.
